shape: someone does a small thing for you and never mentions it; name that as love

slides.text: mum tilted the umbrella over your backpack the whole walk, and [[just shook her wet sleeve at the door]].

caption:
her left shoulder was soaked through before you even reached the gate.
she just hung her coat on the peg and put the kettle on.
mum was always taking the rain first.
send this to the person who still texts to ask if you brought a jacket.

#mother #mumquotes #motherdaughter #motherson
alt: a short post about a mother holding an umbrella over her child's backpack and shaking out her own wet sleeve at the door.
